Financial assistance

LCMC Health financial counselors help patients and families understand assistance programs that may reduce healthcare costs.

The page explains how to review eligibility information, begin an application, and find support when medical bills create financial hardship.

Explore financial assistance
fields.pageSummary: Get guidance from LCMC Health financial counselors and explore programs that may help with healthcare costs.

fields.Detail:
Price transparency

LCMC Health provides pricing resources to help patients understand possible costs before receiving care.

Because actual responsibility depends on services, insurance coverage, and individual circumstances, patients can use the available tools and contact the appropriate hospital for additional guidance.

Review price transparency resources
